faq.title: Jaguar XJ 306DT FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers about pricing, warranty, outputs and fitting for the Jaguar XJ 306DT engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XJ 306DT engine replacement?
faqs.a: Costs depend on the engine type you choose and whether we fit it. Send your registration and we'll provide a written quote with parts and labour itemised.

faqs.q: Are your 306DT engines covered by a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Engines we supply carry a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for third-party fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Did the 1996 Jaguar XJ use the 306DT?
faqs.a: No. The 1996 XJ was offered with petrol engines only. The 306DT arrived with the X351 XJ from late 2009, so we confirm your engine code using the VIN.

faqs.q: Was the XJ's 3.0 diesel ever rated at 241hp?
faqs.a: Parts catalogues list the XJ's 306DT at 275hp and 300hp. The 241hp rating appears in XF listings, so we always verify your engine's exact output before supplying a replacement.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ 306DT engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include crankshaft bearing wear, crank pulley failure, turbo actuator faults, oil cooler leaks and DPF problems. Symptoms overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver a 306DT to my garage?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK to homes and independent garages. We confirm compatibility first and explain warranty conditions for outside fitting.

faqs.q: What is included in your XJ supply and fit service?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XJ. Timescales are confirmed with your quote.

workshopIntro.title: Choosing Between Repair and Replacement for Your 306DT
workshopIntro.description: Diagnosis must come first. Oil cooler leaks, crank pulley failure and turbo actuator faults are frequently repairable without replacing the engine. If bearing failure has damaged the crankshaft or block, compare the repair estimate with your XJ's age, mileage and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XJ 306DT engine replacement cost depends on which engine type you choose, its condition and whether fitting is included. Removing a V6 from a large saloon involves considerable labour, so complete supply and fit quotes are the fairest comparison.

When browsing 306DT 3.0 V6 diesel engine UK listings, check which model the engine came from, its output and recorded mileage. Units from Land Rover SUVs may need different parts, so detailed, honest answers matter.

Finally, review the warranty. A Jaguar XJ 306DT engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault develops after installation. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms and conditions clearly before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ 306DT Engine Problems Explained
engineProblems.description: These symptoms may suggest a fault; only proper diagnosis can confirm it.

cards.title: Knocking From Below
cards.description: A heavy, rhythmic knock that rises with revs may point to crankshaft bearing wear, a reported weakness on this V6.

cards.title: Sluggish Mid-Range Pull
cards.description: Power that fades once revs build could suggest a problem with the secondary turbo, its actuator or vacuum supply.

cards.title: Oil Warning Messages
cards.description: Low oil pressure warnings might relate to oil level, sensor faults or internal wear, so they shouldn't be ignored.
cards.action: Check the level before driving further.

cards.title: Front Pulley Vibration
cards.description: Shaking at idle or noise from the front of the engine could indicate a failing crankshaft pulley damper.
cards.action: Have the auxiliary drive inspected promptly.

cards.title: Fluid Leaks Underneath
cards.description: Oil or coolant pooling beneath the car may come from an oil cooler, water pump or coolant pipe leak.

cards.title: Recurring DPF Messages
cards.description: Repeated particulate filter warnings may mean regenerations are not completing, especially if the XJ mostly covers short trips.
cards.action: Ask for a DPF and EGR assessment.

engineOverview.title: How the 306DT Powers the X351 Jaguar XJ
paragraphs: The 306DT is a 2,993cc twin-turbocharged V6 diesel from Jaguar Land Rover's AJV6D family, badged 3.0 SDV6 in the X351 XJ. Catalogues list it from late 2009 at 275hp, with a 300hp version appearing from 2015, both driving the rear wheels of this long, refined luxury saloon.

A Jaguar XJ 306DT engine 1996 search won't find a match, because XJ models of that era were petrol-only, and the earlier X350 diesel used a 2.7-litre V6. Equally, the Jaguar XJ 3.0 V6 diesel engine 241hp figure belongs to XF listings rather than the XJ.

Because the 306DT is shared with other Jaguar and Land Rover models, ancillaries, sumps and calibrations can vary. Matching by VIN protects you from fitment surprises. Where bearing or crankshaft damage is serious, replacement is often more practical than a full strip-down repair.
